# Large-location directory collection

Five additional Corporate directory systems: Metropolitan Ledger (66 fictional locations), Campus Grid (72), Atrium Register (60), Night Exchange (72), Foundry Atlas (60). Each has native 3840×2160 and 2160×3840 layouts and independently authored photography placement, typography, hierarchy and palette.

Reuse the existing DirectoryBoardEditor: image library/restore, all visible text, compact location rows and list import, company-name or natural numeric suite sort, fit one screen or automatic pages, Make 2 pages, eight transition choices, seconds per page and simple motion speed. All content stays separate from layout in directoryDocument. No new operator settings.

Suite fitting reserves measured space for complete suite codes; large-location heading fitting supports long names and respects explicit text styles. Artwork is AI-generated illustrative architecture, replaceable via the native media companion. Portrait adaptation reflows the whole design. Fictional Corporate system defaults are ACTIVE; Ala Moana remains private to Brookfield and DRAFT/source review with only six of 66 rows recovered.

Validation: 20 new CMS browser flows in Chromium/WebKit (five systems × two orientations), four existing regression flows, two targeted long-heading flows, 10 existing editor unit tests, 40 composition checks across fictional/private data, 162 runtime cases (64 photo, 64 orientation adaptation, 32 motion, two heading style cases). The standalone gallery/editor and extracted file prototypes are also checked in both engines. Posters and provenance are regenerated; shared editability and Taurus gates pass.

The install manifest is additive: 44 Corporate standards (32 directories + 12 touch) and 32 private Brookfield variants. The installer validates exact live asset hashes, target tenant and super-admin identity, preserves existing records and writes audit rows. It does not change schedules or display assignments. Verification artifacts and source/image provenance are included in the downloadable package.
